item.title: GARDEN CLIPPINGS: Palms enjoy indoor home environments
item.description: Palm trees are to Florida like tulips are to the Netherlands. Or sugar maples to northern Ontario. Intriguing, then, to see palm trees happily growing at the northern shore of Kitsilano Beach in West Vancouver.
